title: A typical month-end workflow
summary: One narrative from import through reports.

paragraphs.text: Month-end is mostly about catching up and closing the loop. A common rhythm looks like this:

items: Import and review pending bank activity; fix accounts and dates, then apply to the ledger.
Scan the ledger for anything that still looks wrong.
Close the oldest open accounting period when pending in that range is clear.
Request the reports you need and download them when notifications say they are ready.

paragraphs.text: Budget plans can run in parallel—they do not block close—but many people tweak the plan after they see how the month actually landed.
